en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow‑covered village in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground a lone skier stands on a slope beside snow‑laden trees, looking down toward the settlement. The village consists of several traditional alpine‑style buildings and barns, dominated by a church with a tall, slender steeple and clock tower. Rolling fields and dense conifer forests stretch into the distance under a pale sky. Along the top border of the image, handwritten text reads "Brück 1075".
